elements.description: Radio group for AI product settings.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Choices with stable values and visible labels.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value; prevent tc-value-change to control it from the application.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Form field name; objects and arrays are serialized as JSON.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable editing and omit the control from form submission.

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: Proposed value (detail: { value }); cancelable to keep application control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show the current validation message and focus the first control.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value when controlled by the application.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when the element owns its state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with proposed edits; controlled values remain application-owned.
